feature: Bank-only wallets and confirmed automatic bank operations
operation_policy: New correct-direction ATM withdrawals/deposits and non-POS Havale/EFT/FAST/Virman principal rows are confirmed signed movement entries affecting this account only.
Movement is excluded from income and spending; no cash wallet, destination owner, paired leg, or cash ledger is fabricated.
Incoming whole-word PREPAID is income with Cashback under the user-approved convention; debit/unknown-sign PREPAID is not auto-income.
Negative identified transfer fees are expenses; specific merchant rules retain priority over generic online purchases.
Unknown flows, opposite ATM signs and non-PREPAID reversal evidence remain unreviewed.
Historical unreviewed bank rows are confirmed only by explicit reviewed Apply; existing non-unreviewed manual financial types are retained.
cash_policy: All currencies: cash removed from new/demo wallets, create/edit choices, preferred-wallet and transfer defaults, import target choices, active balances, spending reports and pending queues.
Only zero-opening cash definitions with no active entry or retained metadata references are removed via the existing revision-guarded writer.
Referenced or nonzero legacy cash remains in a read-only archive and financial backup; existing bank/cash transfer history is retained and not editable through individual or bulk forms.
preservation: All writes retain Web Locks, captured expectedData and token CAS, failure drafts and retry guards.
Manual categories/rules, archived targets, deleted defaults and deliberate suggestion modes are protected; v3-to-v4 changes only exact untouched bank defaults and adds incoming-PREPAID rule.
Immutable source wording outranks edited notes, including blank source descriptions; historical fingerprint algorithm is unchanged.
Source-backed confirmation preserves signed postings, IDs, dates, notes, source facts and links, updating only explicitly reviewed type/category annotations.
Movement form accepts positive nominal plus explicit direction; both orientations of explicit pairing preserve both balances, source dates and fingerprints without extra entries.

sample_readonly_proposal.scope: Read-only in-memory proposal; no financial document or browser storage written

review_findings_resolved: Negative movement nominal could invert selected direction; nonpositive nominal is now refused.
Cash-linked legacy ordinary records could remain selectable for bulk edits; all selection/application paths now refuse them.
Positive movement conversion to internal transfer needed credited-wallet orientation and existing movement pair candidates; both sides now tested.
retained_initial_attempts: work/bank-auto-unit-integration.json: old cash-active fixture expectations updated to bank/ewallet while genuine cash archive coverage was added.
work/bank-auto/original-final: generic pending-credit fixture changed from known Havale to an unknown incoming description, retaining pending behavior coverage and exact balances.
work/bank-auto/category-final: FAST import expectation updated to confirmed movement, preserving source/money assertions.
work/bank-auto/candidate-1: currency-label selector corrected; 12/13 passed before selector fix.
work/bank-auto/bank-description-candidate-1: archived/capacity assertions updated to allow independent type confirmation without reactivating removed categories.
limits: Chromium on Windows and mobile emulation only; no physical Safari/iOS/Android or manual screen-reader claim.
Current suites prove the tested cases; full cloud A-H recovery and legacy missing evidence remain incomplete.
Full UI performance and 65k interactive rendering were not repeated for this feature; unit capacity/overflow and large-backup browser regression passed.
New movement backups require a version supporting plain wire3 or source codec4; old online code is unchanged and is not a supported target for these new backups.
packaging: Combined ZIP/off-PC backup deferred by user; prior snapshots retained.
ci: New bank-only browser gate configured locally in existing workflow; remote CI not executed.
